description:
Introducing Publi-Cite: A Web3-Powered Advertising Platform Overview:

Publi-Cite is a revolutionary Web3-powered advertising platform where users earn rewards per click, third-party websites gain commissions, and companies achieve seamless ad engagement.

How Publi-Cite Works:

Advertiser Registration & Campaign Creation:

- Any advertiser can visit Publi-Cite, register, and create a campaign for their products.

During the campaign setup, the advertiser must define:

- Reward per Click (amount paid per user click)
- Third-Party Commission Percentage (share for websites displaying the ads)
- Optional End Date (campaign duration)

Funding the Campaign:

- Upon registration, a server wallet is automatically created using Privy Server Wallet API calls.
- Advertisers must fund their server wallets to activate and run campaigns.

Campaign Management:

- Advertisers can track and manage their campaigns through the Campaign Display Section, where they can view their ads and add funds as needed.

Third-Party Website Integration:
- Any third-party website can search for live campaigns and copy the embedded ad component to their site.
- Websites displaying campaigns earn commissions per user interaction.

User Interaction & Rewards:

When a user clicks an ad on a third-party website, the reward per click is automatically credited to their browser wallet using Web3 technology.

Tech Stack:

Publi-Cite leverages cutting-edge Web3 technologies to ensure security, transparency, and efficiency:
- Privy Server Wallet 
- Idempotency Keys 
- Privy Policies Engine 
- Privy Authentication Signatures
- Embedded Links 

Future Roadmap:

To enhance security and fairness, we plan to develop anti-spamming modules to prevent multiple-account exploitation and introduce advanced policy controls to regulate ad interactions. Our vision is to establish Publi-Cite as the Web3 alternative to Google Ads, offering a decentralized, fair, and rewarding digital advertising experience superior to Brave Ads.
Join us in revolutionizing online advertising with Web3 technology!
how_its_made:
Our project revolutionizes digital advertising by utilizing Privy server wallets to automate payments for advertising campaigns. Users are rewarded with cryptocurrency for engaging with ads, providing a unique value-driven experience. By leveraging the Privy policy engine, we effectively manage reward distribution while preventing spam through the use of Idempotency keys.

 Despite facing challenges with documentation, the active Privy developer community on Slack helped us overcome issues swiftly, allowing us to focus on creating a seamless Web3 alternative to traditional ad platforms like Google Ads.
